text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads up — we're formalizing partner SEV handback rules after last week's marketplace outage. Quick sync: propose a 3-tier flow + channel naming. Can we confirm owners?

Ethan (Eng Oncall): +1. Need a hard rule: who triages in the first 15m. Oncall should own initial triage until Partner Eng is paged.

Priya (Partner Success): Agreed. Partner Success should own outbound comms to partner PM/CS once triage confirms impact. Also we need a canonical runbook link (post any updates here).

Maya (Partnerships): Draft proposal below — please comment inline.

```
Channel naming: #partners-<partner>-sev-<sev-id>
War room alias: #warroom-<sev-id> (auto-created)
Triage (0-15m): Eng Oncall (ack + preliminary severity)
Escalate (15-60m): Eng Oncall + Partner Engineer + Partner Success + Marketplace Ops
War room (>60m or P1): cross-org war room + Exec oncall + Legal (if customer-facing comms)
Handback: Once stable, Partner Success owns partner-facing summary and next steps; Eng writes technical postmortem.
Access: Partner Eng must have onboarding SSO and runbook VPN checklist before war room.
```

Sam (Marketplace Ops): For marketplace-related incidents, add @marketplace_ops and cloud-partner alias to the channel by default so billing/regional infra can jump in. Also we should auto-post deploy/job traces from CI bots.

Jorge (Partner Engineer): +1 on SSO/VPN checklist. Also want a short "liaison schedule" so each partner gets a rotating technical contact for faster auth + permissions. We had delays last incident because creds weren't pre-shared.

Lina (Legal): For any public statements or status page text that mentions the partner by name, please loop legal before posting. We can triage within the war room but need a named approver.

DevOpsBot: Created test channel <#partners-acme-sev-20260403|#partners-acme-sev-20260403> and posted starter template (runbook, triage checklist).

Maya (Partnerships): Action items: 1) update partner playbook with this flow and add runbook link 2) adopt channel naming template + auto-creation via bot 3) run a mock war room next Wed 10am PT to exercise handbacks. I'll assign owners below.

Priya (Partner Success): I'll own the mock war room coordination and the partner comms template. PR opened: https://redwood.internal/docs/partners/playbook/pulls/34

Ethan (Eng Oncall): I'll add a "partner liaison" flag to the oncall rota and ensure first-15m triage steps are in the runbook.

Jorge (Partner Engineer): I'll draft the SSO/VPN checklist and post to the playbook by EOD Friday.

Sam (Marketplace Ops): I'll add the marketplace aliases to the bot auto-creator and ensure CI trace posting works in test channel.

Lina (Legal): I'll provide a 1-page checklist for approvals (status page, joint statement, press) — will post to the war room template.

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll fold this into the partner onboarding checklist and run the mock. Closing the thread here. :thumbsup:
